estimates.anchor_source: NO_EXTERNAL_ANCHOR (A16-13). No market prices Airbnb's interest income; revision 1's 0.11 was M7's own LIVE quantile, i.e. the same rule the decomposition runs, at a pre-hike vintage. The adjacent Kalshi Fed ladders are a genuine external input and set the rate path (claim 6), but they price the Fed, not this line, so they are not an anchor for the question.

model.structure: II = beta N(0.88,0.045) x r N(4.10,0.15)/100 x avg base/4 x (1 + N(0,5%)); base = cash N(12,100/12,000, 500) + funds held (7,209 / 6,959) x (1 + N(12.7%,3%)) x (1 - U(0,10%)); YES <=> II <= 145.8. Mixture: base 0.885 (0.0133) / ramped upsize $1.5bn 0.07 (0.062) / ramped upsize $3bn 0.03 (0.207) / T-bill 3.25 0.005 (0.665) + 0.010 unmodelled cash-draw and presentation tails = 0.036
model.revision_2_changes: buyback-upsize branches now RAMP the incremental draw (750/1,500 and 1,500/3,000 rather than the full amount at both quarter-ends, since the earning base is the average of the two quarter-ends): conditionals 0.096/0.381 -> 0.062/0.207 (A16-06). Emergency-easing branch 0.02 -> 0.005 (A16-18: the Kalshi ladders are deep and live and price a single December cut at 0.01-0.02, while that branch needs about three). Section 7 recomputed at mixture level (A16-19).
model.conventions: object = income-statement 'Interest income', three months ended 31 Dec 2026, from the release table (else FY26 less 9M); 4Q25 base $162M as printed (FY25 $705M less 9M $543M); gross of interest expense

extreme_probability_gate.note: sum ~0.036. Confirmed at 0.04 not 0.03 because the buyback branch is correlated with the memo's own thesis and the cash-draw tail is unmodelled; not 0.05 because the ramp correction is arithmetic, not judgement. The one force pushing below 0.04 is Q4 seasonality in beta (see beta_q4_note).

beta_q4_note: Claim 4 records that both Q4 realisations of the yield ratio are high (0.966 in 4Q24, 0.942 in 4Q25) against the rule's 0.876 and a non-Q4 mean of 0.842, and revision 1 then centred a Q4 question on the non-Q4 parameter. At a Q4-appropriate centre of 0.90 the base regime falls 0.0133 -> 0.0064 and the mixture to ~0.030. M7's registered 0.88 is kept (n = 2 is a thin seasonal) but the bias is one-sided and toward No.

impact.note: Below adjusted EBITDA: no margin effect. At $145M vs the team path's $165M (-$20M; FY27 run-rate -$90M vs M7's $765M): 4Q26 EPS -$0.03, FY27 EPS -$0.130 = -$90M x (1-0.175) / 573m shares (run convention for FY27 rows; cross-check, the line-build sensitivity +/-100bp = +/-$0.28); stock -$2 at a cash-yield multiple. EV 0.04 x -2 = -$0.08/share: immaterial. Rates are now a tailwind to this line, so the RNPL cash-timing point belongs on unearned fees (C12), not here.
